The '''Balaidas Academy''' was an academy which taught [[police science]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] barred [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] from attending. [[Detien Kaileel]] studied there.<ref name="ACPOV">{{JournalCite|8|A Certain Point of View (short story)}}</ref>
